title: Complete source preservation and first acquisition wave

review_basis.qualification: Selection review and bounded artifact-specific verification, not a fresh audit of every underlying source.

policy.raw_preservation: Preserve complete useful permitted originals, meaningful historical versions, all original fields/uncertainty and provenance. Rights, legitimate access, integrity and bounded storage govern this stage.
policy.canonical_mapping: Downstream semantic mapping, adapter acceptance and statistical interpretation are separate; unfinished mapping is not a prerequisite for lawful raw preservation.
policy.public_publication: Private archive retention and public redistribution eligibility are separate from permission to publish. No public raw-data publication is performed by this policy document.
policy.metadata_only: Fallback for restricted or unresolved bodies. The strict metadata queue is a separate component, not a universal retention restriction.
policy.compact_data_in_Git: Complete compact licensed CSV/JSON datasets may be reviewed for Git publication alongside normalized measurements and provenance. Metadata-only retention is not required.
policy.bulk_history_in_Drive: Bulky originals, binary/document archives and many historical vintages remain in the verified private archive with stable content hashes and manifest references.
policy.source_specific_rights: No data grant inferred solely from another artifact or a software license. Keep unknown rights/access held; check current source terms and denials.
policy.deduplication: One physical source blob per complete SHA-256 plus byte length; retain all source/version/retrieval/license/supersession edges. Transport archives and duplicate exports are not new sources.
policy.execution: No live collector, canonical adapter, scoring change, new credential, public sharing, paid LFS or automatic cap increase is enabled.

capacity.initial_transfer: Sequential bounded complete originals with space reserved for original, temporary and full raw-readback copies.
capacity.extension: Review an exact artifact-specific larger total bound and connector-supported transfer; chunking must preserve every byte and require offsets, lengths, part hashes, whole reassembly/hash, version consistency and complete raw readback. Do not silently bypass the tested whole-artifact bound.
capacity.backend_limits: Current connected archive transport supports bounded transfers and raw readback; direct quota/preallocated-ID/resumable controls and standalone backend credentials are not established.
capacity.cleanup: Reconcile uncertain uploads before retry. Cleanup only tracked transfer scratch after all expected files, raw checksums and checkpoint verification succeed.

summary.selected_total_qualification: Mixed measured full-body lengths and explicitly labelled HTTP advertised lengths; not total acquired corpus bytes.
summary.packaging_is_not_source: The verified 96,127-byte transfer ZIP contains three source originals totaling 661,699 bytes plus support files. Count those three originals, not the ZIP as an extra source.
